name: daily_brief_ask_titles_v2
description: Brief Needs-you (aegis-zmk): active seeds titled "ASK Stiwi", found from the rdfs:label index. Item, title and status only. Active statuses are enumerated (open, in_progress, blocked, deferred); measured ~0.06-0.15s vs 6-9s for the v1 closed/tombstone FILTER.
scope: every open seed whose title starts with ASK Stiwi; overflow is UNKNOWN
template: PREFIX seeds: <https://seeds.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?item ?title ?status WHERE { GRAPH <https://seeds.local/project/aegis> { ?item rdfs:label ?title . FILTER(STRSTARTS(?title, "ASK Stiwi")) ?item seeds:status ?status . VALUES ?status { "open" "in_progress" "blocked" "deferred" } } } LIMIT 300
